problem: Notifications account settings showed Ответ сервера не соответствует API MeetSpace.
rootCause: Android required the removed summary Boolean on GET /api/v1/notifications/preferences and always sent it on PUT. The current API returns and accepts only invitation, reminder, recording, email, push.
fix: Treat summary as an absent legacy-only preference when the response has no such field; never send it in that case.
Preserve both true and false summary values when an older server exposes them.
Only show the legacy summary toggle in the notification dialog when the server supports it.
Keep all five supported Boolean flags mandatory and reject missing/null/string/number/object values. Preserve email and push when changing event categories.
liveTestSafety: Saved the existing notification settings unchanged, re-read them, and logged out. No account preference changes or server deployment required.
limits: UI exercised on a disposable API 36 arm64 emulator; no physical Android device connected.
Live HTTPS repository validation and emulator UI validation run separately.
